title: Sure-almost-sure and Sure-limit-sure Window Mean Payoff in Markov Decision Processes
summary: Given rationals $α$ and $β$, the sure-almost-sure problem for a threshold Boolean objective $\varphi$ in a Markov decision process (MDP) asks if one can simultaneously ensure that all outcomes of the MDP have $\varphi$-value at least $α$ (i.e. sure $α$ satisfaction) and with probability $1$ the outcome has $\varphi$-value at least $β$ (i.e. almost-sure $β$ satisfaction). The sure-limit-sure problem asks if for all $\varepsilon > 0$ one can simultaneously ensure that all outcomes have $\varphi$-value at least $α$ and with probability at least $1 - \varepsilon$ the outcome has $\varphi$-value…
